reviewed_boundaries.finding: Authority checked before reading IDs/paths; only existing validated documents under held State. No GenerationManager or TransactionPins calls.
Rollback direction uses original SelectedBase; rejects equal/higher targets; selected-target retries preserve original base. Independent mutant allowing equality is detected.
B2 record revalidated through B1.3 and B3 shape on recovery. Independent missing-shape mutant is detected.
Activation always recovers again then solely delegates B1/D8.2. Corruption after earlier recovery blocks execution. No legacy fallback or additional authority.
Same-generation different-ID replay, stale bases, nested value detachment, independent expected hashes, collision and fresh source observation checked.
State/TransactionLease/StoreGc hierarchy and external-writer exclusion unchanged; archive not GC root; independent reference and lifetime remain caller prerequisites.

fault_injection.existing_B2_SIGKILL: Required regression in full suites; not a new B3 power-loss proof

lifetime_evidence: Real metadata discard after State release succeeds for B2-only target; B3 then refuses missing target. Inactive target after D4 publication is retained by existing D4/D5. Process-wide State reentry rejects. No changed GC contract or manufactured lifetime token.
concurrency_evidence: Two fresh exec processes use distinct pinned requests with the same base; State serialization yields exactly one winner and one SelectionConflict, no loser D4 publication/rebase. Does not cover arbitrary hostile writers or simultaneous C++ mutation.
physical_witness_scope: Actual D2 hard-linked symlink inode and same-text replacement; direct D2 rejects stale witness, B3 preserves unrelated inode. Successful B3 payload projections remain empty.
